name: Canonical Master Records State Transition Custody
purpose: Submit each observed governed state transition receipt to the existing Master Records custody/reconstruction authority and require exact reconstruction before machine-owned progression continues, without promoting custody into transition authority.
trigger: a governed state transition decision, execution consequence, denial, failure, partial outcome, or fail-closed state has been observed
scope: one observed governed state transition receipt
reuse_instructions: Use this for the canonical per-state-transition custody consequence. Task-specific probes may compare conformance but must not replace this path. Interlock/InTr remains transition authority and TV/TVC remains credential authority where required.
